title: Restrictions of the concrete binary submodule
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $W,V$ opens, $H$ a module sheaf on $X$ and $Q$ on $V$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $\iota:Q\to H|_V$. Suppose the restriction of $\iota$ to $W\cap V$ is an isomorphism. Then the first projection $\varphi$ of [def-weil-pbc-module-binary-submodule-pullback] restricts to an isomorphism on $W$, and $G|_V$ is isomorphic to $Q$. No monicity, quasi-coherence or finiteness is needed.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PF (lemma-extend), binary gluing paragraph; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PF

proof.text: At an open T contained in W, the site pullback T intersect V is contained in W intersect V. Evaluating the overlap hypothesis gives an isomorphism on this open. Restriction of scalars preserves this isomorphism and the canonical transport isomorphism. Evaluation preserves pullbacks, so the evaluated first projection is an isomorphism. Assemble component inverses and reflect the resulting presheaf isomorphism to module sheaves.
The second identification is binarySubmodule_on_V, which needs no overlap hypothesis.

proof_origin.note: Concrete Lean implementation of the cited gluing paragraph; local properties also follow Definitions 01BE and 01B5, read on the Stacks website.

lean.statement:
theorem binarySubmodule_restrictions
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (Q : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))
    (ι : Q ⟶ H.over V)
    [IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      (homOfLE (show W ⊓ V ≤ V from inf_le_right))).map ι)] :
    IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      (homOfLE (show W ≤ W ⊔ V from le_sup_left))).map
        (binarySubmoduleInclusion X W V H Q ι)) ∧
      Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (show V ≤ W ⊔ V from le_sup_right))).obj
          (binarySubmodule X W V H Q ι) ≅ Q)
